# Residential Remodeler Insurance

> Residential Remodeler Insurance (by Contractors Choice Agency) provides commercial insurance for this trade in all 50 states. Coverage lines: General Liability Insurance for residential remodeling contractors, Workers' Compensation for residential remodeling contractors, Commercial Auto Insurance for residential remodeling contractors, Tools & Equipment Coverage for residential remodeling contractors, Completed-Operations Coverage for residential remodeling contractors, Commercial Umbrella Insurance for residential remodeling contractors, Commercial Property Insurance for residential remodeling contractors, Contractors Pollution Liability for residential remodeling contractors. A-rated carriers. Licensed in all 50 states — NPN #8608479. Founded 2005. Contact: 844-967-5247, josh@contractorschoiceagency.com.
